**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

**Role Summary / Description**
 Senior Engineer role in AI/ML Computational Science focused on designing, building, and integrating scalable scientific AI, simulation intelligence, computational modeling, optimization, and ML\-enabled engineering solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
   

  

 Role scope: As a Senior Engineer, you will lead a technical workstream, guide implementation choices, mentor engineers, contribute to solution design, and support delivery leadership within a larger program.
   

  

 The role converts computational science and engineering problems into practical AI/ML components, scientific data pipelines, model workflows, and reusable cloud\-native patterns that support scalable client outcomes.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the design and build of AI/ML computational science components that support scientific data ingestion, simulation result processing, feature engineering, model development, deployment, and monitoring.
   

  

 Translate scientific, engineering, and business problems into practical ML, optimization, surrogate modeling, simulation analytics, and data engineering solution patterns.
   

  

 Develop production\-quality Python, SQL, API, workflow orchestration, and cloud\-native components that integrate with broader enterprise platforms.
   

  

 Work with technical architects, data scientists, domain experts, cloud engineers, product owners, and delivery leads to ensure solution components integrate cleanly with the wider system architecture.
   

  

 Guide junior engineers on implementation practices, code quality, testing, documentation, reproducibility, observability, and delivery readiness.
   

  

 Contribute to design reviews, technical decision logs, implementation plans, estimation inputs, sprint delivery, and risk mitigation activities.
   

  

 Build reusable assets such as data pipeline templates, model workflow patterns, notebooks, APIs, deployment scripts, validation utilities, and implementation playbooks.
   

  

 Support client discussions by explaining technical options, trade\-offs, implementation constraints, and evidence for recommended AI/ML computational science approaches.
   

  

 Stay current with scientific AI, generative AI, agentic workflows, MLOps, digital twins, optimization, and cloud\-native computational engineering patterns, and share learnings with the team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computational Science, Data Science, or a related field.
   

  

 Minimum 5 years of experience in AI/ML, data science, computational science, scientific software engineering, simulation analytics, or quantitative engineering solutions.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing AI/ML, data engineering, scientific computing, or cloud\-native analytical solutions.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience with Python and scientific/ML frameworks such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit\-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, XGBoost, or similar libraries.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience with MLOps or production ML practices including experiment tracking, model registry, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and lifecycle governance.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience with scalable data pipelines, distributed compute, batch/stream processing, APIs, workflow orchestration, and containerized deployment patterns.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience leading a technical workstream, mentoring engineers, or guiding implementation within a larger program.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Strong hands\-on knowledge of AI/ML computational science workflows, scientific data processing, numerical modeling, optimization, simulation analytics, feature engineering, and model deployment patterns.
   

  

 Strong Python, SQL, Git, testing, documentation, API, container, and workflow orchestration skills for robust, reusable, maintainable engineering delivery.
   

  

 Practical experience with ML approaches relevant to computational science, including surrogate modeling, physics\-informed ML, optimization, time series, anomaly detection, computer vision, NLP, generative AI, and uncertainty\-aware modeling.
   

  

 Working knowledge of MLOps, model governance, responsible AI, security, data privacy, observability, performance monitoring, and production support practices.
   

  

 Ability to partner with domain experts and convert scientific concepts, equations, simulation outputs, experimental data, and engineering constraints into buildable AI/ML solution components.
   

  

 Strong collaboration skills with ability to work across engineering, research, product, client, and delivery teams across multiple time zones.
   

  

 Industry experience applying AWS\-enabled AI/ML computational science solutions in domains such as life sciences, healthcare, energy, utilities, manufacturing, chemicals, materials, aerospace, automotive, financial services, or public sector research.
   

  

 2\+ years of hands\-on AWS experience across AI/ML development, scientific data pipelines, scalable compute, data engineering, and secure cloud integration.
   

  

 Experience with AWS services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Batch, EKS, ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, Glue, EMR, S3, FSx/Lustre, OpenSearch, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and containerized deployment patterns.
   

  

 Ability to build AWS\-based components for simulation data ingestion, surrogate modeling, optimization workflows, model training/inference, model monitoring, and production deployment.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computational Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, or a related field.
   

  

 External client\-facing consulting experience, including technical discovery, implementation planning, solution demonstrations, or delivery support.
   

  

 Experience with HPC, GPU acceleration, CUDA, MPI, distributed training, workload schedulers, or cloud\-based parallel compute patterns.
   

  

 Experience with digital twins, scientific foundation models, materials informatics, computational chemistry, bioinformatics, geospatial analytics, industrial optimization, or engineering simulation workflows.
   

  

 Experience with agentic AI workflows, RAG, vector search, knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or scientific knowledge management.
   

  

 Experience creating reusable accelerators, implementation playbooks, solution design notes, proof\-of\-concept assets, or technical enablement material.
   

  

 Cloud, data, AI/ML, MLOps, or professional engineering certifications relevant to the selected platform.

title: Senior Principal Engineer, Search Platform
description:
****Overview****
****Working at Atlassian****
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Your future team: Search Platform**
 The Search Platform team is responsible for powering Rovo Search , knowledge discovery and search for humans and agents across all enterprise data. Our mission is to make all our customers' data across Atlassian and their external apps (i.e. third\-party applications) searchable securely and reliably through an insanely fast, globally scalable, cost\-efficient, enterprise grade search infrastructure. Powering search and discovery in the agentic era is a whole new challenge and this team is at the forefront for Atlassian.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
 As a Senior Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will own technical roadmap, execution and outcomes for the Search Data pillar. You will help envision, build and evolve a cutting\-edge platform for integrating, processing, indexing and searching massive volumes of unstructured data across 100\+ sources. Your deep expertise in large\-scale data platforms, streaming and batch processing and distributed systems to solve some of our most complex problems including infrastructure, data and dev/agentic productivity challenges. Data is messy and hard and its the most critical, make or break input for Search and AI.
   

  

 As a senior technical leader, you will be expected to lead other engineers to define our strategic technical direction, and to own outcomes from design to launch. Your role is pivotal in identifying and driving step\-change initiatives, choosing the problems to solve vs not, in order to deliver a world\-class end\-to\-end search experience, powered by rich data which is fresh, reliable across all apps.
   

  

****Responsibilities:****
* Collaborate with technical leads, partner teams and internal customers to define technical strategy and architecture for Search Data.
* Lead the evolution of our data platform and pipelines to meet the demands of both real\-time search freshness and AI/agentic retrieval at enterprise scale.
* Make hard architectural trade\-offs between freshness, correctness, cost, and operational simplicity \- and own the outcomes.
* Drive the simplification and modernization of complex, legacy data processing systems. Identify and eliminate unnecessary complexity. Design systems that are understandable, testable, and operable.
* Establish design patterns and best practices for handling the inherent messiness of real\-world data \- schema evolution, partial failures, eventual consistency, connector variability, and data quality degradation.
* Own engineering and operational excellence for the health of our systems and processes. Proactively drive opportunities for continuous improvements and own key operational metrics.
* Transform developer productivity to ensure that we unleash the potential of our own team with agents. Champion a culture of high ownership, rigorous testing, safe rollouts, and data\-driven engineering across Search Data teams.
* Help hire and mentor engineers to build an open, innovative and operationally responsible culture.


****Qualifications****
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

****Requirements:****
* Deep experience with distributed data frameworks (Kafka, Flink, Spark) \- you have built, operated, and debugged systems processing billions of events per day. Ideally for Search and AI use cases where innovation relies on iterating over data. You understand their failure modes, not just their happy paths.
* Strong background in designing data architectures that handle messy, heterogeneous data at scale \- including schema evolution, data quality, idempotency, backfill/replay, and partial failure recovery.
* Track record of simplifying complex systems. You have taken spaghetti systems and turned them into something engineers can reason about, test, and operate confidently.
* Demonstrated department\-level technical leadership, influence across multiple teams, and ownership of top\-level technical objectives tied to business outcomes. You identify ambiguity and bring clarity.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals. Fluency in at least one modern language (Java preferred). You write code, review code, and hold a high bar for engineering quality.
* Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex data architecture to engineers, product managers, and leadership with equal clarity.
* 12\+ years of experience imagining, building and operating critical systems at scale.


****Benefits \& Perks****
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
****About Atlassian****
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh**

title: Sr. Principal Architect-Data
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

**Principal Architect\-R4**
**Databricks AI Design \& Architecture \| Agentic AI Systems**
 As a Principal Architect for Databricks AI \& Agentic Systems, you will own the end\-to\-end technical strategy and architecture of Lilly's AI data platform. You will design the systems that enable autonomous, multi\-agent AI workflows—spanning data ingestion, semantic modeling, model orchestration, and real\-time decision intelligence—while setting the architectural standards the engineering organization builds against.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor and technical leadership role. You will be the definitive technical authority on Databricks architecture, agentic AI design patterns, and AI/ML platform engineering—directly influencing how Lilly uses AI to transform pharmaceutical R\&D, commercial operations, and patient care.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Architecture \& Agentic System Design**
* Architect multi\-agent AI systems on Databricks, defining agent orchestration frameworks, tool\-use patterns, memory/state management, and inter\-agent communication protocols.
* Design agentic workflows that combine LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and structured data reasoning to support autonomous decision\-making pipelines.
* Establish architecture patterns for agent\-to\-agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent, integrated within the Databricks ecosystem.
* Define how AI agents interact with Unity Catalog assets—tables, models, volumes, and functions—as tool surfaces for autonomous data retrieval and action execution.
* Architect real\-time and near\-real\-time agentic pipelines leveraging Databricks Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables, and event\-driven triggers.


**Databricks Platform Architecture**
* Own the Databricks Lakehouse architecture end\-to\-end: catalog/schema design, medallion architecture (raw → refined → curated → AI\-ready), storage optimization, and multi\-workspace governance.
* Define and enforce Unity Catalog standards for AI assets—model registries, feature tables, vector search indexes, and function\-as\-a\-tool registrations—enabling governed AI consumption across the enterprise.
* Architect the semantic and metrics layer so business logic is expressed once, consistently consumed by BI tools, AI agents, and downstream APIs.
* Set Delta Lake standards: table properties, Z\-ordering, partitioning strategies, liquid clustering, and cost\-based optimization for petabyte\-scale workloads.
* Design Databricks Model Serving architectures, including real\-time inference endpoints, batch inference pipelines, and A/B model deployment patterns.


**AI/ML Platform \& LLM Integration**
* Define the enterprise architecture for LLM integration on Databricks—covering prompt management, context assembly, vector stores (Databricks Vector Search), embedding pipelines, and LLM fine\-tuning workflows.
* Architect MLflow\-based model lifecycle management: experiment tracking, model versioning, champion/challenger patterns, and governance\-compliant model promotion.
* Design feature engineering and feature serving architectures using Databricks Feature Store, ensuring AI agents have low\-latency access to curated, consistent features.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging Databricks AI capabilities—Mosaic AI, AI/BI Genie, DBRX, and Databricks Apps—as first\-class architectural components.
* Define patterns for responsible AI: model monitoring, drift detection, explainability, audit trails, and bias mitigation within regulated pharmaceutical contexts.


**Governance, Security \& Data Quality**
* Define and enforce data governance, access control, lineage, and auditing across all Databricks workspaces using Unity Catalog and integration with enterprise identity providers.
* Architect data quality frameworks (Great Expectations, Databricks DQ rules, or equivalent) embedded into AI pipelines to ensure model inputs meet reliability standards.
* Define security architecture for AI workloads: network isolation, secret management, encryption\-at\-rest/in\-transit, IP restriction, and compliance with GxP and GDPR requirements.
* Own data sharing architecture—Delta Sharing, external connectors, API gateway patterns—ensuring downstream AI consumers receive governed, versioned data surfaces.


**Technical Leadership \& Standards**
* Own architectural decision records (ADRs), reference architectures, and platform blueprints that engineering teams build against independently.

description:
**Overview**
 JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.
   

  

 Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Senior Software Engineer
   

  

**Experience Level** 
 : 5\-8 years of professional experience in the applicable field.
   

  

**Education** 
 : Requires a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Senior Software Engineer is a fully competent professional responsible for delivering complex software solutions by applying broad and deep knowledge of engineering principles, practices, and procedures. This role involves significant technical ownership, with assignments that demand originality, ingenuity, and the ability to make independent decisions that influence the organization’s projects or clients. The Senior Software Engineer cooperates with Architects to identify reference patterns and best practices and mentors and guides junior or intermediate engineers, providing technical direction and oversight when needed.
   

  

 The candidate, being in contact with other engineering teams in Europe, India and US, will work to the creation of a microservices architecture built in Java, Spring, React deployed in a container\-based environment (Kubernetes) into a cloud infrastructure
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, and implement complex software systems and applications, ensuring high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
* Apply broad technical expertise to solve advanced problems and deliver innovative solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, code reviews, and architectural planning sessions.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to Associate, Junior, and Intermediate Software Engineers.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams (e.g., product managers, QA, DevOps) to define and implement requirements.
* Take ownership of projects, ensuring completion within scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify areas for process improvement and recommend enhancements that may have significant business impact.
* Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, or frameworks to improve the development process.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for specific systems, components, or business areas.
* Provide recommendations that influence client deliverables or organizational decisions.


**Position Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline (Master’s degree a plus).
* 5\-8 years of professional experience in software engineering or application development.
* Proven experience in Java programming especially with Spring framework (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data, etc.)
* String experience with API development (REST or GraphQL) and integration projects, with focus on security and performances.
* Proficiency with ORM frameworks and relational databases best practices
* Knowledge of JavaScript frontend frameworks (especially React) is preferred.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and system scalability.
* Experience in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with secure coding practices and performance optimization.
* Experience in leveraging AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) and apply prompt engineering to accelerate delivery across development, testing, and operations.
* Able to design and build integrations with LLM services and cloud AI platforms, collaborating with Architects and Product teams to embed AI capabilities and agentic workflows into products.
* Good command of English (written and spoken)


**Skills And Competencies**
* Exceptional problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills with a high level of technical innovation.
* Strong ability to independently evaluate and make technical decisions with minimal supervision.
* Good communication and leadership skills for collaborating with stakeholders and guiding junior engineers.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks, proposing solutions, and driving technical strategy.
* Ability to manage broad, challenging assignments with originality and ingenuity.


**Work Environment**
* Operates as a senior\-level individual contributor with minimal lead\-level or middle management intervention.
* Provides oversight and guidance to Associates or Intermediate Engineers.
* Has appreciable latitude for independent action and decision\-making on critical tasks.
* Contributes to strategic technical recommendations that impact business outcomes.

 At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well\-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.

TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.

* Metrics\-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course\-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

title: Senior C# Architect
description:
**About the company:** 




 Our client is a wellness technology company dedicated to helping organizations build healthier, more engaged, and productive workplaces. It offers customizable employee wellness programs that align with organizational culture, values, and business goals.
 



 The company combines fitness technology, mobile applications, web\-based tools, health content, and wellness services such as fitness classes, webinars, and health coaching. Its platform enables employees to track healthy habits, participate in wellness activities, earn rewards, and engage in friendly challenges, helping organizations foster a strong culture of health and well\-being.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We're looking for a Senior C\# Architect to own the technical architecture of our core platform, spanning legacy ASP.NET MVC/Web API services and modern cloud\-native systems. You'll balance hands\-on coding with high\-level design, guide a team of engineers, and drive decisions on scalability, performance, and modernization including migration paths from .NET Framework to .NET 8\+.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own end\-to\-end architecture for ASP.NET MVC and Web API applications, including API design, service boundaries, and data access patterns
* Lead technical design reviews and set coding/architecture standards across teams
* Drive cloud infrastructure decisions (AWS) compute, networking, storage, caching, and managed database services
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in production systems (SQL Server, IIS, connection pooling, caching layers)
* Design and implement caching strategies (Redis/ElastiCache) to decouple read\-heavy workloads from primary databases
* Guide migration strategy from ASP.NET Framework (4\.x) to .NET Core/.NET 8\+, including hosting model changes (IIS to containerized/cloud\-native)
* Architect for high availability, disaster recovery, and horizontal scalability
* Mentor senior/mid\-level engineers on system design and code quality
* Collaborate with product and infra teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Own technical documentation, RFCs, and architecture decision records (ADRs)
* Participate in incident response and root\-cause analysis for critical production issues



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* Deep expertise in C\#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API (both .NET Framework and .NET Core/.NET 8\+)
* Strong background in RESTful API design, versioning, and security (OAuth2/JWT)
* Proven experience architecting solutions on AWS (EC2, RDS, ElastiCache, Lambda, S3\) equivalents
* Solid SQL Server expertise: query optimization, indexing strategy, execution plan analysis, stored procedures
* Experience with distributed caching (Redis) and message queuing (SQS, RabbitMQ)
* Strong understanding of IIS configuration, application pools, and Windows Server hosting environments
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
* Track record of leading legacy modernization/migration projects
* Excellent communication skills able to explain architecture tradeoffs to both engineers and business stakeholders



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Experience with microservices architecture and event\-driven design
* Familiarity with Entity Framework/EF Core and ORM performance tuning
* Exposure to mobile backend architecture (APNs, push notification systems, mobile API design)
* Experience in health/wellness, fintech, or other regulated/data\-sensitive industries
* AWS/Azure architecture certification



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 



* Reduced latency and improved scalability on high\-traffic APIs
* Clear technical roadmap for legacy\-to\-cloud\-native migration
* Fewer production incidents tied to architecture\-level issues (connection pooling, caching gaps, DB contention)
* Mentored engineers taking on more architecture ownership over time

title: Senior/Principal Software Architect & Manager
description:
**Senior/Principal Software Architect \& Engineering Manager** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a
 **Senior/Principal Software Architect \& Engineering Manager** 
 to provide hands\-on technical leadership for our Agentic AI software team.
 



  





 This is a
 **player\-coach role** 
 for an experienced software architect who has built and delivered complex commercial software products through multiple complete product lifecycles. You will own the overall software architecture while directly managing a team of approximately 10 software engineers.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can think several years ahead architecturally while still being willing to get into the code today.
 



  





 The right candidate will help us build our Agentic AI platform for long\-term scalability, maintainability, security, performance, and customer deployment—rather than continually solving new requirements through patches and one\-off solutions.
 



  





 This is
 **not a pure management position and not an advisory architecture position** 
 . You will be expected to remain deeply technical and hands\-on.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




 You will have overall responsibility for the architecture and engineering execution of our Agentic AI platform, including:
 


* Define and continuously evolve the overall software architecture.
* Design the product for future scale, extensibility, maintainability, reliability, and performance.
* Make architectural decisions across services, APIs, databases, data pipelines, AI infrastructure, orchestration, deployment, and related software components.
* Identify architectural weaknesses before they become major technical debt.
* Establish clear technical standards, design patterns, interfaces, and development practices.
* Ensure new customer requirements are incorporated through scalable product architecture rather than customer\-specific patches or forks.
* Lead major technical design reviews and architecture discussions.
* Personally participate in coding, prototyping, debugging, code reviews, and implementation of critical components.
* Review and improve existing architecture and code where necessary.
* Directly manage approximately 10 software engineers.
* Mentor senior, mid\-level, and junior engineers and develop stronger architectural thinking throughout the team.
* Work closely with company technical leadership to translate product vision and technical concepts into scalable software architecture.
* Drive engineering planning, execution, quality, and accountability.
* Establish strong development, testing, release, and deployment processes.
* Own technical decisions related to customer deployment, upgrades, versioning, configuration, security, and supportability.
* Help determine when to refactor, rebuild, or extend existing components.
* Balance near\-term delivery requirements with long\-term architectural integrity.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Required Experience** 



* **12\+ years of professional software engineering experience.**
* Significant experience as a
 **Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Technical Lead, Engineering Manager, or similar senior technical role** 
 .
* Demonstrated experience architecting
 **complex commercial software products sold to external customers** 
 .
* Experience taking
 **multiple software products through the complete product lifecycle** 
 , from early architecture and initial development through production deployment, scaling, upgrades, maintenance, and future generations.
* Experience with software deployed in
 **customer\-controlled or customer\-hosted environments** 
 , not exclusively SaaS or internally developed corporate applications.
* Strong experience designing software for scalability, modularity, extensibility, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Strong hands\-on software engineering background with the ability and willingness to work directly in the code.
* Experience managing and technically leading software engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, databases, concurrency, performance, and system integration.
* Experience making architectural decisions that must support multiple customers, configurations, environments, and future product requirements.
* Strong code review, debugging, troubleshooting, and technical problem\-solving skills.



  





**Commercial Product Experience Is Critical** 




 We are specifically looking for someone who understands the difference between developing internal software and building a commercial product that must operate reliably in many different customer environments.
 



  





 The ideal candidate has dealt firsthand with areas such as:
 


* Product installation and deployment
* Customer\-hosted software
* Software upgrades and migrations
* Backward compatibility
* API and schema versioning
* Configuration management
* Licensing
* Security and access control
* Observability and diagnostics
* Performance and scalability
* Failure recovery
* Dependency management
* Release management
* Automated testing
* Deployment automation
* Supporting multiple customer environments without maintaining customer\-specific codebases
* Long\-term technical debt management



  





**Hands\-On Technical Leadership** 




**We expect this person to remain technically engaged.** 




**You should be comfortable:** 



* Opening the codebase and understanding how the product actually works.
* Writing code when appropriate.
* Building proof\-of\-concept implementations for important architectural decisions.
* Debugging difficult production and integration issues.
* Reviewing pull requests and critical code.
* Working directly with engineers to solve difficult technical problems.
* Challenging designs that may work today but will create scalability or maintenance problems later.
* Refactoring or redesigning areas of the product when necessary.



  





 Candidates whose recent experience has been primarily people management, project management, or high\-level architecture without hands\-on technical involvement are unlikely to be a fit.
 



 Engineering Management
 



 In addition to being the senior architectural leader, you will directly manage the software engineering team.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Managing approximately 10 software engineers.
* Setting engineering priorities and technical direction.
* Assigning ownership and ensuring accountability.
* Mentoring and developing engineers.
* Improving engineering discipline and software development practices.
* Conducting technical and performance reviews.
* Helping recruit and evaluate future software engineering hires.
* Ensuring the team can execute quickly without sacrificing architectural quality.
* Building a strong engineering culture focused on quality, ownership, practical problem solving, and continuous improvement.


- 


**Preferred Experience** 




**Experience in one or more of the following would be valuable but is not required:** 



* Enterprise software platforms
* Developer tools
* AI/ML or LLM\-based applications
* Agentic AI systems
* Retrieval systems, RAG, or GraphRAG
* Knowledge graphs or graph databases
* Large\-scale data ingestion and processing
* Search and indexing platforms
* Distributed systems
* Infrastructure software
* Cybersecurity products
* Observability or DevOps platforms
* Complex engineering or scientific software



  





 We value exceptional software architecture and commercial product experience more highly than prior semiconductor\-domain knowledge. The domain can be learned.
 



  





**The Person We Want** 




 You are likely someone who has seen products evolve from an early\-stage architecture into mature commercial platforms—and have learned from both successful architectural decisions and decisions that later became expensive technical debt.
 



  





 You naturally ask questions such as:
 


* What happens when there are 500 customers instead of 50?
* What happens when the dataset becomes 100 times larger?
* How will we upgrade this component two years from now?
* How do we add capabilities without continually modifying the core?
* How do we support different customer environments without creating separate versions of the product?
* Where are the architectural boundaries?
* What should be configurable versus customized?
* What failures should we anticipate now?
* What will become difficult to change later?



  





 You are comfortable making major architectural decisions, but you are equally comfortable sitting beside an engineer, reviewing code, debugging a difficult issue, or building an implementation yourself.
 



  





 Level
 



 This position may be hired at either the
 **Senior Software Architect** 
 or
 **Principal Software Architect**

 We are seeking a visionary Technical Architect with deep specialization in Financial Services (FINS), Retail \& Consumer Goods (RCG), Automotive, OR Manufacturing sectors, alongside mastery of the Salesforce ecosystem and AI\-first engineering practices.
   

  

 In this role, you won't just be designing systems; you will be a Trusted Advisor, guiding our premier enterprise clients through complex, AI\-driven digital transformations. You will bridge the gap between ambitious business goals and robust technical execution, maintaining a "Full Stack Mindset" that covers everything from high\-level discovery to hands\-on deployment.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Architectural Leadership: Lead the end\-to\-end design and architecture of complex, multi\-cloud Salesforce solutions specifically tailored for FINS, RCG, Automotive, or Manufacturing challenges.
* Enterprise AI Architecture: Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits.
* Architectural Simulation \& Design: Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases.
* Cross\-Cloud Innovation: While rooted in Salesforce, you will explore and integrate solutions across Industry Clouds (Financial Services Cloud, Consumer Goods Cloud, Automotive Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud, or Revenue Cloud) and third\-party ecosystems to ensure the business receives the most efficient solution.
* Discovery to Go\-Live: Own the technical and functional scope throughout the project lifecycle. This includes leading discovery workshops, defining data governance and guardrails, and ensuring a smooth transition to Go\-Live.
* Team Orchestration: Provide technical governance and mentorship to large, diverse teams of developers and testers, ensuring code quality, security models, and architectural integrity.
* Hands\-on Excellence: While your focus is strategic, you are willing and able to "get into the weeds" to solve high\-complexity technical hurdles or build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) when required.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Domain \& Technical Expertise**
* Multi\-Domain Specialist: Extensive experience navigating at least one key industry landscape—Financial Services (FINS), Retail \& Consumer Goods (RCG), Automotive, OR Manufacturing.
* Salesforce \& Industry Cloud Mastery: Proven track record in Salesforce architecture, with a focus on Financial Services Cloud (FSC), Consumer Goods Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or Revenue Cloud (CPQ \& Billing), alongside Sales/Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* AI\-First Delivery Methodology: Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects.
* Complex Engagements: Experience leading at least 3\+ large\-scale, complex Salesforce implementations for global enterprise brands across target industries.
* Full\-Stack Mindset: Comfort working across the entire stack—from UI/UX considerations and Apex/LWC development to complex integrations (MuleSoft/REST/SOAP) and data architecture.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

The team serves as the single point of contact for all security, privacy, and compliance\-related customer engagements within the Genesys Cloud Business Unit.

 **Cloud Security Architect**

This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing technical security role, not a compliance or GRC position. You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Security, and Architecture teams to support consulting, customer audits, security assessments, technical reviews, executive briefings, and evidence\-based engagements for Genesys Cloud.
   

  

 As one of the team's technical security SMEs, you will apply your expertise in cloud security, AI security, and security controls to explain and defend the Genesys Cloud security, privacy, and compliance posture. You will interpret technical evidence, respond to complex security inquiries, defend security contractual terms, and engage directly with customers, partners, auditors, and executive stakeholders within the APAC region.

You will regularly represent Genesys Cloud during customer executive briefings, security workshops, webinars, conferences, partner events, and industry forums. description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 AWS India is looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to help advise our Financial Services \& Insurance (FSI) customers in India on how to best adopt and leverage the value of AWS technology. This is an ideal role for someone with deep experience in the FSI industry, expert knowledge of financial services applications and infrastructure and a solid understanding of the transformational value cloud technologies can bring.
   

  

 In this role, you will engage with customers in India to determine business needs, identify opportunities and issues, and develop related technical solutions and value propositions leveraging the power of AWS cloud technology.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 \#aws\-ags\-India
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Design customer solutions with a focus on the Financial Services industry, collaborating with the AWS Business Development function and internal teams in India to help customers migrate to AWS cloud\-based technology solutions.
* Architect solutions leveraging AWS technology, including solution development and potentially demonstrate technical feasibility through mechanisms including proof\-of\-concepts and/or prototypes.
* Serve as a thought leadership, evangelizing AWS services and technologies through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public\-speaking opportunities such as AWS first\-party events and third\-party industry events.
* Capture and share best practices and insights internally and with Partners and customers in India.
* Identifying customer requirements and providing feedback into appropriate AWS services teams. Provide updates on customer progress and ensure plan execution by partners.
* The right individual will leverage FSI Industry expertise, architecture experience, and customer\-facing skills to be a "trusted advisor" to customers. They will be able to facilitate relationships with senior executive stakeholders, as well as easily interact with and give guidance to technology experts, software developers, IT professionals, and system architects to ensure better CX and compliance with global AWS standards, practices and policies.
* The right individual will also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges. If you are someone who enjoys innovating, likes solving hard problems and working on cutting edge technology, we would love to hear from you.


**Basic Qualifications**

title: Engineering Manager - Product (Python)
description:
Sia Partners is a next\-generation global management consulting firm, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Paris, France. The firm is recognised for its innovative approach, combining strategy and management consulting with data science and creativity. Sia Partners serves a diverse range of sectors, including energy, banking, healthcare, and technology, providing services to over 1,000 clients worldwide, including many Fortune 500 companies. With a strong emphasis on delivering tangible results and superior value, Sia Partners is committed to helping clients navigate the digital revolution and achieve transformation. The firm operates with a global presence, employing over 3,500 consultants across 48 locations in 20 countries
   

  

  

  

 Our Mumbai office was launched in 2024, marking an exciting new chapter for us. We’re building the team with people who are eager to shape something from the ground up — combining the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a startup with the backing and reach of a global brand.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Sia Partners is looking for an Engineering Manager \- Product to support the design and delivery of next\-generation AI and Generative AI platforms within Sia’s AI Factory. This role is pivotal in bridging high\-level product vision with robust, cloud\-native engineering execution.
   

  





 You will work closely with product, data science, and platform teams to translate business and client requirements into robust technical solutions. The role requires strong Python expertise, experience with distributed systems and microservices, and a pragmatic approach to delivering reliable, scalable systems in enterprise environments. In addition to technical delivery, you will contribute to architectural decisions, raise engineering standards, and support client\-facing engagements through technical leadership and clear communication.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  




* Team Leadership: Hire, coach, and retain top\-tier software and cloud engineers. Establish trust through architectural design sessions and code reviews, fostering a culture of ownership, high performance, and continuous innovation.


* Cloud \& Product Strategy: Define and drive quarterly technical roadmaps that align software delivery with business priorities. Lead the evolution of our cloud ecosystem, focusing on scalability, cost\-optimization, and seamless AI integration within our SaaS products.


* Architecture \& Cloud Design Reviews: Ensure the highest standards of scalability, security, and performance across all cloud\-based services. Embed architectural guardrails and "Cloud\-First" best practices, ensuring documentation and coding guidelines are followed.


* Hands\-On Technical Influence: Contribute targeted PRs (scaffolding, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, developer experience improvements) to maintain a pulse on the codebase without occupying the critical delivery path.


* Operational Excellence: Uphold the philosophy of "you build it, you run it." Optimize CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment strategies to increase delivery velocity while maintaining system stability.


* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Research, and Ops to transform ambiguous product requirements into actionable technical milestones, ensuring frequent delivery of customer\-visible value.


* Talent Development: Engage in recruiting and empowering premier engineering talent. Attract and develop engineers who excel in collaborative environments and are passionate about building world\-class software products.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or Physics.


* Over 8 years in software development, with at least 2 years in a leadership role managing software or cloud engineering teams. Proven track record in the technology product sector with a deep understanding of SaaS lifecycles.


* Core Skills: Expertise in algorithms, data structures, and distributed systems. Deep understanding of cloud\-native design patterns and microservices architecture.


* Languages \& Frameworks: Strong proficiency in Python (core) or Working familiarity with Node.js and React.js is highly valued.


* AI\-Native Engineering Leadership: Experience managing teams that utilize Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude Code as a core part of their daily workflow.


* Cloud Expertise: Extensive experience building and launching modern SaaS products on public cloud platforms, specifically AWS. Proficient in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).


* Leadership \& Communication: A decisive leader who prioritizes action and outcomes. Outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across global functions. Strong command of English (written and verbal) for effective communication at all organizational levels.


* Global Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to lead in a global environment, attracting and retaining top engineering talent while working across different time zones and cultures.



**EM \- Product Traits (What Success Looks Like)**



* AI Product Ownership: Owns delivery of AI/GenAI products from problem framing to production impact.


* Outcome\-Driven Delivery: Focuses on business value, not just model or feature completion.


* Product–Engineering Alignment: Partners tightly with Product / Business to convert AI use cases into executable plans.


* Technical Judgment: Understands AI system trade\-offs (latency, cost, accuracy, reliability) and challenges decisions when needed.


* Delivery Predictability: Breaks complex AI initiatives into incremental, shippable milestones.


* Quality \& Reliability: Ensures production\-grade AI systems (monitoring, failure handling, iteration readiness).


* Client \& Stakeholder Communication: Clearly explains AI limitations, risks, and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders.


* Team Leadership: Builds and grows high\-ownership product engineers and applied AI teams.


* Managing Ambiguity: Operates effectively with evolving requirements and experimental problem spaces.


* Calm Ownership: Leads with accountability under delivery pressure and changing priorities.


**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**



* Opportunity to lead cutting\-edge AI projects in a global consulting environment.
* Leadership development programs and training sessions at our global centers.
* A dynamic and collaborative team environment with diverse projects.



**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)**

title: Technical Leader - Software Architect Level 2
description:
**Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader**
 We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.
   

  

**Your Mission, Roles And Responsibilities**
****Overall Responsibilities and Duties****
 Faurecia Clarion Electronics (FCE) is seeking a
 **Software Architect** 
 to lead software architecture activities for automotive products and platforms. The role is responsible for defining, evaluating, and maintaining software architecture, allocating requirements, ensuring traceability, and supporting the development of scalable, secure, and ASPICE\-compliant software solutions from RFQ through production.
   

  

****Roles \& Responsibilities****
* Define and maintain software architecture based on functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Allocate software requirements to architectural elements and ensure end\-to\-end traceability.
* Define software interfaces, system interactions, timing behavior, and resource utilization (RAM, ROM, Flash).
* Evaluate architecture alternatives and recommend optimal technical solutions.
* Ensure compliance with ASPICE, Functional Safety, Cybersecurity, and customer requirements.
* Support software development teams in architecture implementation and technical decision\-making.
* Lead architecture reviews, risk analysis (DFMEA), issue resolution, and corrective actions.
* Monitor architecture progress, performance, logging, diagnostics, and vehicle network integration.
* Drive innovation, cost optimization, software reuse, and future architecture improvements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and promote engineering best practices.


**Your profile and competencies to succeed**
**Qualifications**
* BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, or related discipline.


****Experience Required****
* 10\-12 years of automotive software development experience, preferably in Cockpit Electronics and ADAS.
* Experience architecting solutions for IVI, ADAS, Displays, IMS/DMS, and Connected Accessories.
* Strong exposure to complete automotive software development lifecycle and ASPICE processes.


****Key Technical Skills****
****Software Architecture****
* Software architecture design, requirement allocation, and traceability.
* Low\-level software, middleware, diagnostics, networking, HMI, cloud, and application architecture.
* Functional Safety, Cybersecurity, and software risk analysis.


****Tools \& Processes****
* ASPICE\-compliant software development processes.
* Atlassian Suite (Jira, Confluence), Rhapsody, and architecture/design tools.
* Experience with performance monitoring, logging, diagnostics, and calibration tools.


****Mindset / Attitude****
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Customer\-focused with a high sense of urgency.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and decision\-making capability.
* Proactive leader with excellent execution and problem\-solving skills.


**What We Can Do For You**
* At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies.
* We are the seventh\-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
* We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast\-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
* We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in\-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)
* We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans.
* Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net\-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1\.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.


**Why join us**
 FORVIA, a global automotive technology supplier, comprises the complementary technology and industrial strengths of Faurecia and HELLA.
   

  

 With over 137 500 people, including more than 12,000 R\&D engineers across 40\+ countries, FORVIA provides a unique and comprehensive approach to the automotive challenges of today and tomorrow. Composed of 6 business groups and a strong IP portfolio of over 12,400 patents, FORVIA is focused on becoming the preferred innovation and integration partner for OEMs worldwide.
   

  

 In 2025, the Group achieved a consolidated revenue of 26\.2 billion euros prior to IFRS 5\. FORVIA SE is listed on the Euronext Paris market under the FRVIA mnemonic code and is a component of the SBF 120 index.
   

  

 FORVIA aims to be a change maker committed to foreseeing and making the mobility transformation happen. www.forvia.com

description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
 For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client\-centric and digitally\-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
   

  

**Job Function:**
 The role is responsible for the technical delivery, data architecture, and operational support of Channel Data Management (CDM) solutions within a complex enterprise environment, with a strong focus on database design, SQL development, and ETL processes.
   

  

 This position defines and delivers high‑value CDM enhancements while ensuring data integrity, system performance, and scalability. The role requires deep expertise in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization, as well as hands\-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines to support data ingestion, transformation, and integration across multiple systems.
   

  

 This position partners closely with IT, Sales Operations, and Data Engineering teams to manage end\-to\-end data solutions—from requirements gathering and backlog prioritization to data pipeline development, production support, and analytics enablement. The role ensures high\-quality, reliable data flows across platforms while translating complex technical and data concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
   

  

 The CDM System Analyst should be highly motivated and passionate about data systems, database technologies, and scalable application architecture. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL scripting, data transformation logic, performance tuning, and troubleshooting data issues across distributed systems. This role requires full ownership of data processes and pipelines, with a commitment to continuously enhancing the CDM ecosystem, improving data quality, and strengthening application and data infrastructure resiliency.
   

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**
* System Operations, Monitoring \& Incident Management
* Provide technical expertise to manage and support complex IT architectures supporting CDM solutions.
* Perform daily CDM system monitoring, including data validation, batch/job execution, and overall system health.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data quality and system issues identified through monitoring activities.
* Manage incidents and changes in alignment with the ITIL framework, including escalation to IT teams and tracking through resolution.
* Maintain, test, and continuously improve business and system operations to ensure stability and performance of 24x7 applications.
* Processes, Technical Solutions, Data \& Analytics Enablement
* Support CDM Operations, Geo Sales Operations, and Data\-to\-Value teams with issue resolution, data loads, mass data updates, and technical guidance.
* Develop SQL\-based solutions to support reporting and analytics needs, including Power BI datasets and reports.
* Build and maintain Business Objects Universes and reports.
* Design and deliver solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform tools.
* Maintain a holistic view of CDM processes and users to assess functional impacts across configuration, workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* Apply deep understanding of CDM business processes and related enterprise systems, including ERP, PLM, CRM, and the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication \& Enablement
* Work closely with technology and operations teams to ensure successful, sustainable delivery of CDM systems, including transitions to IT operations.
* Provide regular project and operational updates (weekly/monthly), and confidently brief executive audiences to support informed, proactive decision\-making.
* Report risks, issues, and progress to IT leadership, escalating as appropriate.
* Develop, deliver, and support training for CDM operations and key user teams, enabling adoption and effective system usage.
* Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Experience and Background:**
**Work History:**
* 5\+ years of experience in designing solutions and defining requirements for CDM platforms and complex IT systems, including hands\-on experience with databases, SQL, ETL processes, and related data systems..
* Excellent communication skills and customer service skills
* Must have strong problem\-solving ability, critical thinking skills, creative/innovative thinking, attention to detail, and previous systems/business analyst experience.
* Must show positive attitude, strong self\-motivation, ability to meet deadlines, and ability to determine appropriate sense of urgency.
* Good understanding of software development life cycles.

title: Principal AI Go-to-Market Operations Engineer
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD is a world\-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a visionary and highly
 **technical AI Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Engineer** 
 to sit at the core of our revenue engine. This is not a traditional operations role; it is a hybrid of software engineering, data science, and revenue strategy. You will be responsible for architecting an AI\-first GTM ecosystem that bridges the gap between Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success.
   

  

 Your goal is to ensure that every individual in our GTM organization and every piece of our technology stack is augmented by Artificial Intelligence. You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* AI Architecture \& Custom Integration
* Design, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components.
* Build proprietary internal LLM\-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects.
* Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e.g., CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow\-up scheduling) across the revenue organization.
* Revenue Ecosystem Optimization
* Partner with RevOps and Marketing Ops to audit the existing tech stack, identifying redundancies where AI can replace high\-cost, low\-utility third\-party vendors.
* Implement predictive modeling to identify high\-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real\-time "Next Best Action" recommendations.
* Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting.
* Cross\-Functional Efficiency
* Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI\-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers.
* Consult with Marketing leadership on AI\-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
* Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in Marketing/Revenue Operations or GTM Engineering. Deep understanding of the "Leads\-to\-Revenue" funnel and "Best\-in\-Class" SaaS ecosystems.
* Ability to write and maintain production integrations — Python, JavaScript, html, or equivalent — connecting AI agents to CRM, MAP, and sequencing tools via APIs. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to ship working code, not just configure no\-code tools.
* Deep working knowledge of the modern B2B GTM stack — specifically Salesforce (as CRM and data hub), Clay, Claude, Outreach, Gong or Chorus, etc
* Proven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance.
* Understanding of pipeline math and unit economics: you should be able to work backward from a revenue target to pipeline required, conversion rates by stage, and the specific AI interventions that move each number. If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD," you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel.
* Experience with AI agent orchestration — managing multiple AI agents working different segments or functions simultaneously, resolving conflicts, preventing duplicate outreach, and maintaining data quality in the hub (Salesforce).
* Demonstrated ability to build prompt libraries, training datasets, and refinement workflows for AI agents — treating agent training as a discipline, not a one\-time setup.
* Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it — and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD And QAD Redzone**
 QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud\-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever\-increasing disruption caused by technology\-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises.
   

  

 QAD Redzone helps to enable QAD’s vision for the Adaptive Enterprise. Labor productivity improvements directly impact efficiency. Productive and empowered employees increase the effective capacity of your plant and accelerate time to productivity for new employees giving manufacturers the agility to increase production beyond what was previously possible without having to invest in production equipment or new plants, and reduce the amount and impact of employee attrition. Empowered employees with a growth mindset take extreme ownership of challenges that impact their production goals, creating resilience in the face of disruption.

title: Senior Partner Solutions Architect
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Atlassian is looking for a
 **Senior** 
**Partner Solutions Architect** 
 , reporting to the International Head of Partner Solutions.
   

  

 This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role
 **requires you to be located** 
 in
 **India.**
 At Atlassian, our mission is to empower customers to thrive in the digital economy by delivering innovative, enterprise\-grade solutions. As a leader in enterprise platform and AI adoption, Atlassian is committed to enabling organizations to unlock the full potential of our Cloud platform by identifying and driving high\-impact use cases that leverage our robust platform capabilities and cutting\-edge AI technologies to solve complex business challenges. In this role, you will lead the development and implementation of tailored solutions that accelerate enterprise transformation with end customers, working closely with partners in the region to understand their customers' unique needs, design scalable architectures, and champion the adoption of AI\-driven workflows and automation. Your expertise will guide partners and customers through every stage of their journey, from discovery and assessment to successful delivery of complex transformation projects, ensuring they realize measurable value from Atlassian’s platform and AI investments.
   

  

**Your future team**
 Our Partner Solutions team brings together experts with deep experience in Cloud Acceleration \& Upgrades, Solution Design, and Architecture. With a strong focus on building partner Enterprise cloud capabilities, we help drive successful cloud transformations by providing technical expertise, strategic guidance, and best\-in\-class solutions to support seamless migrations and enterprise adoption.
   

  

 This is a
 **unique opportunity** 
 to help shape
 **the future of Atlassian’s Partner ecosystem** 
 . If you are passionate about technology, innovation, strategy, and driving business impact, this could be the perfect role for you.
   

  

 In this role, you will drive digital transformation and AI initiatives, leveraging your expertise in product, consulting, and sales. You’ll work closely with partners and stakeholders in a matrix environment, articulate the value and technical benefits of SaaS platforms, and guide customers through secure cloud migrations and transformations. You’ll also develop deep knowledge of the Atlassian platform, becoming a subject matter expert to support customer success.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead Partner capability strategy, across the India market in collaboration with Global Cloud Leaders, Solution Strategists, Customer support, Partner \& Alliances, and Sales to grow and accelerate AI\-powered platform solutions.
* Lead India channel capability efforts focused on Enterprise cloud and AI market success.
* Collaborate with Atlassian Partners to create packaged implementation platform services, solutions, and GTM strategy.
* Conduct Enterprise cloud \& AI capability, technical, and practice workshops with Partners.
* Partner with enterprise sales, to educate on partner capabilities and optimize the co\-selling motion.
* Lead and collaborate across Atlassian, to build and deliver a coordinated capability model.
* Focus on and lead cloud thought leadership programs.


**Qualifications**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Your background**
* Experienced in product, consulting, and sales for digital transformation across different markets.
* Strong business acumen with consultative selling skills.
* Proven success in building effective internal and external partnerships.
* In\-depth understanding of SaaS platform benefits and underlying technologies.
* Broad knowledge of cloud and AI technologies, with the ability to dive deep when needed.
* Collaborative experience working with partners/GSIs.
* Willingness to become an Atlassian product subject matter expert.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**
